messages:
cheng: onboarding astrax-lite-7b-int4 to dedicated cluster. seeing consistent entity drops in long-summary evals vs fp16. suspect rotary phase + kv-cache packing mismatch after export + some tokenizer normalization edgecases. anyone seen diacritic token shifts after int4 conversion?

maria: saw similar on orpheusx exports. usually a combo of unicode normalization (NFC vs NFKC) and a head-index reordering from packing differences.

sam: can you paste a small repro and which quant pipeline you used? (our block-int4 vs custom script?)

cheng: repro from eval harness (longctx=2048):
input: "R\u00e9sum\u00e9 \u2014 meeting notes: Discuss budget for Q3; attendees: Jos\u00e9, Zo\u00eb, S\u00f8ren."
fp16_summary: "Budget for Q3 discussed, attendees Jos\u00e9, Zo\u00eb, S\u00f8ren. Action: follow-up on line items."
int4_summary: "Budget for Q3 discussed, attendees Zo\u0117, Soren. Action: follow-up."  # dropped Jos\u00e9 and diacritics mangled
We used our int4 pipeline (block-quantize + symmetric rounding) with headwise kernel on.

eli: first triage: diff token ids under export tokenizer vs HF tokenizer with NFKC. also check for sentinel insertions.

ciara: check runtime head packing. int4 kernels sometimes re-pack heads (group-of-3 vs group-of-4) and if export assumes earlier packing, rotary index -> token id mapping breaks.

sam: tests to isolate: 1) run tokenizer with NFKC and compare ids; 2) run fp16 weights through int4 runtime path (no quant) to see kernel packing effect only.

maria: running NFC vs NFKC token id diff, back in 20m.

cheng: export args: `--export-format rw-fused --rotary-mode headdim-offset --norm none` 80012345 maybe norm none was wrong.

rotary-checker-bot: lint: export rotary=headdim-offset; detected uneven headpacking for int4-v2. recommend `rw-check-rotary --compat`.

ciara: int4-v2 packs heads in groups of 3; fp16/int4-v1 used groups of 4. will add remap shim in runtime to translate indices.

sam: plan:
- maria: tokenizer normalization diff + token id dump (owner)
- cheng: re-export with `--rotary-map remap-per-head` (owner)
- ciara: add runtime compatibility shim that remaps pack indices (owner)
- eli: run full summarization+regression evals after artifacts (owner)

maria: NFC vs NFKC token ids for a few problematic names: on some samples NFKC reduces token count by 1 (Jose\u0301 -> Jose9 canonicalization). attaching list to RW-1234.

ciara: landed shim branch, unit tests pass. canary build `int4-v2-remap-202` uploaded to s3.

cheng: re-exported with remap-per-head, local run shows entity recall +12% closer to fp16. pushing weights to RW-1234.

eli: kicking off evals now, ETA ~40m. if results recover, roll canary; otherwise fallback to fp16 for this model until we fix export/quant path.

sam: nice. keep notes concise on RW-1234: kernel packing change, tokenizer normalization edgecases, remediation steps.

cheng: will update ticket with eval results. thanks all :thumbsup:
